508:t_1:173.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'm sorry for speaking out of turn. But...」

508:t_1:175.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Come to think of it, we've known each other a long time. I doubt I could fool those eyes of yours.」

508:t_1:176.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Is this because of $$シャア・アズナブル$$?」

508:t_1:178.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「There seems to be considerable unrest among the soldiers too.」

508:t_1:179.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ジンネマン$$, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$, and the others defected. Now the former Leader who abandoned them has suddenly returned...」

508:t_1:180.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Perhaps his blatant act of surrender was intended to undermine us from within.」

508:t_1:181.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Your Excellency, you should know better than anyone that he isn't that sort of person.」

508:t_1:184.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「During the $$多元戦争$$, when I was to meet him for the first time, as he represented the $$エゥーゴ$$, you told me this.」

508:t_1:185.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「'That man will surely not tolerate your existence... But what he rejects is the distortion called $$ジオン$$ that required a double of $$ミネバ・ザビ$$.'」

508:t_1:186.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Now that you mention it, that did happen...」

508:t_1:187.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「At the time, I thought you understood him.」

508:t_1:188.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...He could not forgive that distortion... my methods, and tried to rebuild $$ネオ・ジオン$$ by becoming its Leader himself.」

508:t_1:189.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「But in the end, he abandoned his responsibility. I cannot forgive that.」

508:t_1:192.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You're lying to your own heart. In truth, what he did...」

508:t_1:193.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You have quite a tongue for a little girl.」

508:t_1:195.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...It seems I've shown you too much of the world's dark side.」

508:t_1:197.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「And now you've learned to sense things you needn't know... things you needn't see.」

508:t_1:199.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$シャア$$ returned to $$ジオン$$ half prepared to die, to settle accounts with what he had done.」

508:t_1:200.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I must do the same.」

508:t_1:202.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm sorry. It seems I won't be able to attend tomorrow's meeting.」

508:t_1:204.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Thank you for staying with me through everything I've done.」

508:t_1:205.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Tomorrow, you will attend a meeting with the representatives of the colonies' self-governing organizations at 16:00.」

508:t_1:207.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't worry. I will handle the substantive discussion. You need only sit there.」

508:t_1:209.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You may be tired, but you will do it. Even if you're a body double, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ needs $$ミネバ・ザビ$$.」

508:t_2:4.en:

508:t_2:5.en:

508:t_2:6.en:

508:t_2:8.en:

508:t_2:9.en:

508:t_2:10.en:
